summary.headline: Astrological Beginnings and Judgments
summary.text: Chapter list of a Florentine codex, covering beginnings, conjunctions and defluxions, terms and faces, universal judgments, fixed stars, thieves, fetal sex, returns and entries, outcomes of the twelve places, and the horoscoping sign, with manuscript folio references. Apomasar is cited on the demonstrated squares of the Sun to the stars, and Spica is named among the bright fixed stars.
